product_summary: AI recruiting platform combining sourcing, CRM, outreach, AI screening, scheduling and analytics on top of the customer's ATS, with agentic workflows and a large open-web candidate database.
current_data_sources: Job boards and open-web professional profiles (~1 billion)
Customer-owned talent pools, campaign and hiring-analytics data

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: With 100+ integration across ATS, CRM, HRIS, and more, hireEZ fits right into the way your team already works.
The full workflow runs on one platform with 40+ native ATS integrations
Solo recruiters start at $494/mo with a 7-day free trial.

newsletter_capability_detail: No newsletter-publication ingestion found. Sourcing is enumerated as ATS, job boards and the open web plus partner candidate databases; newsletters appear only as something hireEZ sends for candidate nurturing ('creating nurturing newsletters'), not as a data source. No public developer API docs for customers located.
verified_gap: hireEZ enumerates its sourcing inputs as the customer's ATS, job boards, the open web and partner databases. Newsletter publications are not a source, so there is no newsletter-derived company, people or sponsor signal for account prioritisation; NF also cannot supply candidate profiles, so the gap is adjacent rather than core.

evidence.quote: Enhanced candidate sourcing from your ATS, job boards, and the open web
over 1 billion professional profiles sourced from the open web
The full workflow runs on one platform with 40+ native ATS integrations

likely_buyer_role: VP Product or Head of Data Partnerships (external data licensing); recruiting-side buyer would be a TA leader, not a data buyer

contact_route.value: Contact sales / book a demo form
contact_route.note: Linked from hireez.com/about-us/; no named person with a public profile verified.

caveats: Fundamental data mismatch: hireEZ needs individual candidate profiles, resumes and contact details, which NF does not produce (NF extracts companies, people mentioned in newsletters, sponsors and topics). hireEZ is also a large data supplier itself (1B+ profiles), so the realistic relationship is data partnership or supplier, not buyer. Pricing is seat/stack-based with a four-week paid verification, so no low-friction entry point.
